text:
Type: organic-shaped nesting tables
Use: holding drinks, books and lamps, coffee or side table; living room, lounge
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: walnut veneer tops, solid wood legs in a walnut tone
Colors: medium warm walnut brown
Shape: set of two softly rounded pebble-shaped tops, thin edges, four round splayed tapered legs, smaller table tucks under the larger, low and light
Feel: warm, organic, elegant, relaxed
Goes with: cream or grey sofas, black or brass accents, woven rugs; mid-century or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: The table surface in walnut veneer and legs in solid walnut give a warm, natural feeling to your room.
